name: Beastmen Raiders

specialRules.name: Animals (no Hired Swords)
specialRules.text: A Beastmen warband may never hire any Hired Swords unless specifically stated with the Hired Sword.

specialRules.name: Special skill: Shaggy Hide
specialRules.text: The model gains a 12 Armour Save that can be combined with other armour as normal.

specialRules.name: Special skill: Mutant
specialRules.text: The Beastman may buy one mutation (see Mutants special rules).

specialRules.name: Special skill: Fearless
specialRules.text: Immune to fear, terror and All Alone tests.

specialRules.name: Special skill: Horned One
specialRules.text: Makes an additional Attack with its basic Strength on a turn it charges.

specialRules.name: Special skill: Bellowing Roar
specialRules.text: Beastmen Chief only. May re-roll any failed Rout tests.

specialRules.name: Special skill: Manhater
specialRules.text: Affected by the rules of hatred when fighting any Human warbands.

equipmentLists.name: Beastman equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Beastmen Chieftain, Shaman, Bestigors, Centigors, Gor, Minotaur

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" of the Chieftain may use his Leadership when taking Ld tests.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.text: A Beastmen Shaman is a Wizard and uses Chaos Rituals.

specialRules.name: No armour
specialRules.text: May choose weapons from the Beastman equipment list but never wears armour.

fighters.name: Bestigor
fighters.notes: Weapons/Armour text says 'weapons chosen from the Beastmen Equipment list' (armour not mentioned).

fighters.name: Centigor

specialRules.name: Drunken
specialRules.text: Roll 1D12 at the start of each turn. On a 1 it must test for stupidity that turn; on 2-11 nothing happens; on a natural 12 it is subject to frenzy that turn. While subject to both stupidity and frenzy it is immune to all other psychology.

specialRules.name: Woodland Dwelling
specialRules.text: No movement penalties for moving through wooded areas.

specialRules.name: Trample
specialRules.text: Hooves give an additional attack which does not benefit from weapon bonuses or penalties (profile A printed as 1(2)).

fighters.notes: Profile Attacks printed as 1(2): 1 base attack, 2 including Trample.

specialRules.name: Lowest of the Low
specialRules.text: Can never become a Hero; if an Ungor rolls 'That lad's got talent' it must be re-rolled.

specialRules.name: Animals
specialRules.text: Chaos Hounds are animals and never gain Experience.

specialRules.name: Bloodgreed
specialRules.text: If it puts all of its enemies out of action in hand-to-hand combat, it becomes frenzied on a D12 roll of 7+.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.text: May gain Experience but may never become a Hero.

specialRules.name: Large
specialRules.text: Any model may shoot at a Minotaur, even if it is not the closest target.

conversionNotes: Shaggy Hide: d6 6+ armour save converted to natural 12 per the 'natural 6 -> natural 12' rule (an 11+ would match the d6 odds better).

Centigor Drunken: d6 '1 / 2-5 / 6' converted to d12 '1 / 2-11 / natural 12' using natural 6 -> natural 12; the 1 result was left as a natural 1 since no conversion is defined for it (odds of the 1 result drop from 1/6 to 1/12).
Minotaur Bloodgreed: D6 4+ converted to D12 7+.
Skill table also has a 'Special' column = Beastmen Special Skills (Shaggy Hide, Mutant, Fearless, Horned One, Bellowing Roar, Manhater), recorded as 'Beastmen Special'. Bellowing Roar is Chief only.
Centigor Attacks printed as 1(2); stored A=1 with Trample as an extra attack.
Bestigor Weapons/Armour text mentions only weapons from the Beastman list; armour left available since the app uses list ids. Verify intent.
Maximum characteristics: Bestigors as Gor but M5, Centigors as Gor but M9 (not modelled in schema).
Minotaur listed under henchmen with Animal rule (gains Exp, never becomes Hero).
